transcript.text: Hi team — we need to lock the CloudScale Summit booth plan this week so design, travel, and staffing can be finalized. Please send me your planning inputs today: Sales, your goals and expected meeting volume; Product, which line you recommend we feature and why; Events, any booth/logistics constraints, including whether the base 6 badges are sufficient or if we should budget for more. I’ll make the final call once I have your input.
